A lounge whose action changes in 9 or more (a third) of the 27 combinations of drive time, competitor coverage and worker-housing share depends on the assumptions more than on the data, so its call is low confidence. Only the assumptions that reach the scoring are varied: drive time (the decay across the 10/15/20-min bands), competitor coverage (the competitors' pull) and worker-housing share (src/model/served.LEVELS_WHY). The model estimates this lounge is performing 2.1x compared to its site; that is context, not scored. The call changes in 7 of 27 assumption combinations, so it holds up reasonably well.
3fb64b4180f055d6.table_caption: Demand and cost are each scored from 0 to 1 against the other salon sites in the lounge's emirate, then averaged into the composite. At or above 0.65 is PROTECT, at or below 0.35 is SHRINK, and anything between is HOLD. The call scores the site, not the lounge's own popularity.
3fb64b4180f055d6.thresholds_note: PROTECT at a composite of 0.65 or more means the lounge clears the bar on most signals, not just one. SHRINK at 0.35 or less means it is weak on most signals. Everything between is HOLD: with no revenue or lease data, strong calls need the signals to agree. A lounge whose action changes in 9 or more (a third) of the 27 combinations of drive time, competitor coverage and worker-housing share depends on the assumptions more than on the data, so its call is low confidence. Only the assumptions that reach the scoring are varied: drive time (the decay across the 10/15/20-min bands), competitor coverage (the competitors' pull) and worker-housing share (src/model/served.LEVELS_WHY). Affluence weighting is off, so it stays at baseline.
